detail.title: Governance-Anchored Framework for Generative AI-Driven Data Insight in ERP Systems
detail.abstract: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems generate extensive structured and unstructured data that remain underutilized due to the complexity of data models and the fragmentation of reporting tools. This paper proposes a Governance-Anchored Generative AI Framework that transforms ERP data into actionable insights while ensuring compliance, accuracy, and transparency. The framework integrates Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for real-time data grounding and a Governance, Risk, and Compliance layer for auditable, policy-enforced control. Together, these layers establish a secure and explainable pathway from data retrieval to decision insight. Drawing on principles of information governance and responsible AI, the model enables multi-persona interaction across business users, consultants, and developers, democratizing data access through natural-language prompts. It also introduces an eightphase empirical validation roadmap for evaluating data accuracy, insight latency, and compliance assurance within enterprise environments. The study contributes to the emerging discourse on data insight management by demonstrating how Generative AI can enhance decision intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于治理的生成式AI框架，将ERP数据转化为可操作的洞察，同时确保合规性、准确性和透明度。该框架整合了检索增强生成(RAG)和治理、风险与合规层，建立了从数据检索到决策洞察的安全可解释路径。
AI.research_question: 如何利用生成式AI技术将复杂的ERP数据转化为可操作的决策洞察，同时确保合规性和透明度？
AI.motivation: ERP系统产生的大量结构化和非结构化数据由于数据模型复杂性和报告工具碎片化而未被充分利用，需要一种能够同时保证数据安全和合规性的智能分析方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息治理理论、负责任AI原则、检索增强生成(RAG)技术、治理风险与合规框架
AI.method: 提出了一个治理锚定的生成式AI框架，包含RAG层用于实时数据基础，以及GRC层用于可审计的政策执行控制，并设计了八阶段实证验证路线图。
AI.findings: 该框架能够建立从数据检索到决策洞察的安全可解释路径，支持多角色用户通过自然语言提示进行交互，实现数据访问的民主化。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数据洞察管理的新兴讨论做出贡献，展示了生成式AI如何增强决策智能，推动了信息治理与AI技术的融合研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了可操作的解决方案，通过八阶段验证路线图评估数据准确性、洞察延迟和合规保证，具有实际应用价值。

title: A Multi-Scale Feature Fusion with Hierarchical Attention Framework for Malware Detection
affiliations: Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing Institute of Technology, City University of Macau, City University of Macau and Beijing Institute of Technology

detail.title: A Multi-Scale Feature Fusion with Hierarchical Attention Framework for Malware Detection
detail.abstract: The rapid proliferation of malware in the era of digital transformation has intensified the demand for effective and scalable detection solutions. While image-based approaches for malware detection have gained popularity due to their efficiency, they face significant challenges such as poor scalability and limited ability to capture cross-scale dependencies, which undermine their robustness against evolving obfuscation techniques. To address these limitations, we propose a Multi-Scale feature fusion with Hierarchical Attention Framework (MalMSHAF) for robust malware detection.Our approach introduces the Laplacian Pyramid Bidirectional Feature Fusion (LPBiFF) module, which utilizes Laplacian pyramid decomposition to extract multi-resolution features from malware images. The bidirectional fusion mechanism, with learnable weights, adapts feature integration across scales, aligning semantic information while preserving distinctive characteristics at various granularities. We further propose a hierarchical attention network that refines feature representations using local window attention to capture detailed patterns, global self-attention to model long-range dependencies, and class attention for discriminative aggregation. This structured learning approach ensures the robust integration of local and global features, enhancing the model's ability to capture both fine-grained and semantic information. Extensive experiments on the BIG 2015 and VirusShare datasets confirm that MalMSHAF achieves state-of-the-art performance in both classification and detection tasks, while simultaneously advancing the engineering applicability of visualization-based malware analysis toward scalable and reliable real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出了MalMSHAF框架，通过多尺度特征融合和分层注意力机制解决基于图像的恶意软件检测中的可扩展性和鲁棒性问题，在多个数据集上达到最先进性能。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够有效处理多尺度特征并捕获跨尺度依赖关系的鲁棒恶意软件检测框架？
AI.motivation: 数字转型时代恶意软件快速扩散，需要有效且可扩展的检测方案。现有基于图像的方法面临可扩展性差和跨尺度依赖捕获能力有限的问题，影响对不断演变的混淆技术的鲁棒性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多尺度特征融合理论和注意力机制，结合拉普拉斯金字塔分解和双向特征融合，以及分层注意力网络。
AI.method: 提出MalMSHAF框架，包含LPBiFF模块（拉普拉斯金字塔双向特征融合）和分层注意力网络（局部窗口注意力、全局自注意力和类别注意力）。
AI.findings: 在BIG 2015和VirusShare数据集上的广泛实验证实，MalMSHAF在分类和检测任务中均达到最先进性能。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合多尺度特征融合和分层注意力的恶意软件检测理论框架，增强了模型对局部和全局特征的鲁棒集成能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 推进了基于可视化的恶意软件分析在可扩展和可靠实际部署方面的工程适用性。

title: Prompt Provenance: Toward Traceable LLM Interactions
affiliations: Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University, Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University, Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University and Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University

detail.title: Prompt Provenance: Toward Traceable LLM Interactions
detail.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) operate as black boxes, with transient inputs and outputs, i.e., there is little trace of the context, agents, or data that shapes responses. Yet every LLM interaction is a provenance event: an activity producing an artifact under the influence of agents and prior states. This paper introduces the Prompt Provenance Model (PPM), a conceptual model for representing the lineage of prompts, completions, and dialogue histories using the PROV framework of the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C). The PPM extends PROV-O to treat prompts as first-class entities, defining relations between user intent, retrieval sources, system messages, and generated artifacts. It is posited that capturing prompt-level provenance is essential for auditability, explainability, and regulatory compliance in LLM ecosystems. Example applications demonstrate its use for research reproducibility, model debugging, and forensic accountability. This paper contends that prompt provenance is foundational to the trustworthy deployment of Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable (FAIR) generative AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了提示溯源模型(PPM)，这是一个基于W3C PROV框架的概念模型，用于表示LLM中提示、完成和对话历史的溯源信息。该模型将提示作为一等实体，捕获用户意图、检索来源、系统消息和生成工件之间的关系，为LLM的可审计性、可解释性和监管合规性提供基础。
AI.research_question: 如何有效捕获和表示大型语言模型中提示和响应的溯源信息？
AI.motivation: LLM作为黑盒运行，缺乏对上下文、代理或数据影响响应的追踪，但每个LLM交互都是一个溯源事件，需要记录活动、代理和先前状态的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于W3C的PROV框架，扩展PROV-O以将提示作为一等实体，定义用户意图、检索来源、系统消息和生成工件之间的关系。
AI.method: 概念模型设计方法，通过扩展PROV-O框架来构建提示溯源模型(PPM)。
AI.findings: PPM能够有效表示LLM交互的溯源信息，支持研究可重复性、模型调试和法务问责等应用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了第一个专门针对LLM提示溯源的系统化概念模型，扩展了PROV框架在生成式AI领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为LLM生态系统的可审计性、可解释性和监管合规性提供技术基础，支持FAIR生成式AI的可信部署。

title: Strengthening Ukraine’s debt position through the lens of European integration

detail.title: Strengthening Ukraine’s debt position through the lens of European integration
detail.abstract:
Ukrainian abstract: У статті розглянуто підхід до оцінки стану боргової позиції України крізь призму євроінтеграційних процесів. Обґрунтовано актуальність зміцнення боргової позиції через погіршення динаміки державного боргу, його структури та впливу на фінансову стабільність країни. Підкреслено значення реструктуризації державного боргу та досягнення домовленостей із кредиторами як ключових механізмів зменшення боргового навантаження. Висвітлено роль кредитних рейтингів міжнародних агентств у визначенні ризиків боргових зобов’язань і їхнього впливу на ймовірність дефолту.
Результати дослідження підтверджують необхідність науково обґрунтованих підходів до управління боргом для зміцнення фінансової стійкості України на шляху до євроінтеграції. Акцентовано на важливості реструктуризації як інструменту уникнення дефолту та зниження соціально-економічних втрат. Оцінено наслідки попередніх реструктуризацій і визначено потребу у стратегічному підході до боргової політики в умовах війни. Аналіз базується на даних міжнародних організацій і наукових працях, що підкреслюють необхідність адаптації до стандартів ЄС у сфері публічних фінансів.

English Ukrainian abstract: The article examines the approach to assessing Ukraine’s debt position through the lens of European integration. The relevance of strengthening the country’s debt position is substantiated in view of the deteriorating dynamics and structure of public debt and its impact on financial stability. The importance of public debt restructuring and reaching agreements with creditors is emphasized as key mechanisms for reducing the debt burden. The role of international credit rating agencies in identifying debt risks and their influence on the probability of default is highlighted.
The research findings confirm the need for scientifically grounded approaches to debt management in order to strengthen Ukraine’s financial resilience on its path toward European integration. Particular attention is paid to the role of restructuring as a tool for avoiding default and minimizing socio-economic losses. The consequences of previous restructurings are evaluated, and the need for a strategic approach to debt policy under wartime conditions is identified. The analysis is based on data from international organizations and scholarly works emphasizing the importance of aligning public finance management with EU standards.

title: Artificial Intelligence and Digital Transformation in Information Management: A Comparative Study between Public and Private Offices in Bangladesh

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence and Digital Transformation in Information Management: A Comparative Study between Public and Private Offices in Bangladesh
detail.abstract: This study explores the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in information management within public and private offices in Bangladesh. As the nation strides towards digital transformation, understanding the differential adoption and impact of AI across these sectors is crucial. The research employs a comparative analysis to examine how AI technologies are implemented, the challenges faced, and the outcomes achieved in both sectors. Findings indicate that while private offices exhibit greater agility and innovation in AI adoption, public offices encounter systemic barriers such as bureaucratic inertia and limited resources. The study concludes with recommendations for policy interventions and strategic initiatives to harmonize AI integration across both sectors, aiming to enhance efficiency, transparency, and service delivery in Bangladesh's public administration.

title: Coordination, Contingency and Coercion: Monetary Sovereignty from Gold to the Dollar
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB) and

detail.title: Coordination, Contingency and Coercion: Monetary Sovereignty from Gold to the Dollar
detail.abstract: This paper is part of a wider research project on monetary sovereignty. It complements Bindseil and Senner (2025a), which reviews the core concepts and definitions, and Bindseil and Senner (2025b), which provides a general overview of monetary sovereignty's benefits, instruments, and various dimensions. This paper, in turn, provides a deep dive into the critical dimensions of monetary policy and currency convertibility, with monetary policy understood broadly as setting the terms and conditions for central banks' balance sheet operations. Today these operations center around interest rate settings, unconventional policies, and, for some, the operations related to promising fixed exchange rate convertibility or to being part of a currency union. For centuries, commodity convertibility promises were another key element. While a priori a non-convertible currency maximizes monetary sovereignty, convertibility promises can have benefits that outweigh the constraints that they put on the central bank balance sheet. This is particularly true for countries further down the currency hierarchy, which face a dilemma because freely floating exchange rates do not necessarily guarantee independent monetary policy if financial capital is allowed to fast-move across borders. Here, solutions between the corners, i.e. neither fully fixed nor freely flexible exchange rate policies, can maximize sovereignty and capital flow policies including foreign exchange interventions can be seen as legitimate instruments. More generally, sovereignty over monetary policy depends on the domestic setup, for example regarding fiscal, labor and financial sector policies, as well as on the international monetary regime. At both the domestic and international level, the capacity to steer the central bank balance sheet with regards to policy objectives like price stability or convertibility crucially depends on coordination, as for example fiscal contraction or speculative capital inflows from foreign financial firms can weaken or overrun attempts by the central bank to ease monetary conditions. Constant adaptation and coordination are needed to preserve and strengthen monetary sovereignty.

AI.tldr: 本文深入探讨货币政策与货币可兑换性的关键维度，分析非可兑换货币与可兑换承诺之间的权衡，指出中间汇率政策可最大化货币主权，并强调国内外政策协调对维护货币主权的重要性。

AI.theoretical_framework: 货币主权理论、汇率制度理论、中央银行资产负债表管理理论、货币可兑换性理论

title: Letter to the Editor: Zonal Statistics -Beyond the Boundaries of Classical Inference
affiliations: Ministry of Health, Iraq

detail.title: Letter to the Editor: Zonal Statistics -Beyond the Boundaries of Classical Inference

contentType.other: This manuscript has been submitted for consideration to Artificial Intelligence in Medicine (Manuscript ID: AIIM-D-25-04022)

detail.abstract: Classical statistics assumes symmetry, uniform variance, and global confidence. These assumptions collapse under epistemic heterogeneity, model bias, or calibration drift. Zonal Statistics re-envisions inference as a landscape of epistemic zones-from Recession to Inflated-each reflecting graded credibility rather than mere dispersion. Building upon constructs such as the Robust Adjusted Mean Interval (RAMI) and the Epistemic Distribution Curve (EDC), it generalizes uncertainty modeling into a comprehensive, zone-aware discipline for modern data science and AI evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了区域统计方法，将统计推断重新概念化为一个由不同认知区域组成的景观，从衰退区到膨胀区，每个区域反映的是分级可信度而不仅仅是离散度。该方法基于稳健调整均值区间和认知分布曲线等构建，为现代数据科学和AI评估提供了一种全面的区域感知不确定性建模方法。

detail.abstract: The present research investigates the spatial disparity in educational resources and its influence on the aspirational divide between two distinct regions within Southwest Delhi-Dwarka and Najafgarh. As part of a larger geographical and sociological inquiry into urban development and educational access, this study examines how the uneven distribution of learning infrastructure, institutional support, and access to knowledge-based ecosystems contributes to the divergence in educational and career aspirations among youth in these localities. Dwarka, a planned urban residential sub-city, has emerged as an educational hub over the past two decades. Its layout, infrastructure, and connectivity have facilitated the growth of public and private schools, coaching centres, ICT-enabled classrooms, libraries, and digital learning environments. The area has a high concentration of English-medium schools, CBSE-affiliated institutions, and private tutoring networks. Additionally, Dwarka's socioeconomic fabriccharacterized by a middle to upper-middle class demographic-enables greater investment in education, exposure to competitive exams, and access to career guidance resources. These material and social advantages significantly shape students' educational goals and career ambitions. In contrast, Najafgarhwhile geographically close-represents a semi-urban to peri-urban landscape with rural roots and uneven urbanization. Educational infrastructure here is marked by underfunded public schools, limited private institutions, and sparse presence of academic support services like libraries or skill-development centres. Moreover, the socioeconomic profile of Najafgarh's residents often limits investment in education, especially for girl children. Students in Najafgarh face barriers such as long commutes, lack of access to advanced pedagogy, poor digital infrastructure, and weak exposure to external academic benchmarks. As a result, even meritorious students often restrict their aspirations to local employment or vocational courses, shaped by perceived constraints and limited social capital. This study employs a mixed-methods research design, combining GIS-based mapping of educational institutions, school quality indices, and coaching facilities with household surveys, in-depth interviews, and student focus groups across both regions. Quantitative data were collected from 400 households and 40 educational institutions, while qualitative narratives were gathered from 60 students and 20 educators. The data reveal stark contrasts: Dwarka exhibits a higher educational infrastructure density and better access to technology and career counselling, while Najafgarh suffers from infrastructural lag and institutional neglect. Furthermore, the analysis uncovers significant differences in aspirational patterns. Students in Dwarka typically aim for professions in engineering, medicine, law, design, and foreign education, whereas students in Najafgarh more often aspire for local employment, teaching, government jobs, or early entry into the workforce. These differences persist even when students from both localities display similar academic aptitude. Gender disparities also emerge more prominently in Najafgarh, where female students face mobility constraints, limited digital exposure, and sociocultural discouragement toward higher education. Policy implications suggest a need for hyper-localized planning in educational resource allocation, especially for peripheral urban zones like Najafgarh. Suggestions include: establishing community-based academic resource centres, mobile digital libraries, subsidized coaching programs, and localized career mentorship networks. Additionally, targeted support for girl students-through scholarships, safe transport, and digital access-can help reduce gendered aspiration gaps. Educational equity policies must also consider non-tangible enablers such as confidence-building, success stories from within the community, and psychological support. In conclusion, this research makes an important contribution to the geography of education by illuminating how spatial location and urban planning produce unequal opportunity structures within the same administrative district. The case of Dwarka and Najafgarh exemplifies how geography, infrastructure, and social norms intersect to create deeply rooted educational and aspirational divides.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了德里西南部Dwarka和Najafgarh两个地区教育资源空间分布不均如何导致青年教育抱负差异。Dwarka作为规划城市拥有丰富教育资源和基础设施，学生抱负更高；而Najafgarh教育资源匮乏，学生抱负受限。
AI.research_question: 教育资源空间分布不均如何影响德里西南部Dwarka和Najafgarh两个地区青年的教育抱负差异？
AI.motivation: 探究城市发展与教育机会不平等之间的关系，特别关注同一行政区域内不同社区间的教育机会差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教育地理学、城市发展理论、社会资本理论、机会结构理论
AI.method: 混合研究方法：GIS教育机构地图、学校质量指数、400户家庭调查、40所教育机构数据、60名学生和20名教育工作者的深度访谈和焦点小组
AI.findings: Dwarka教育资源密度高，学生抱负多为工程、医学、法律等专业；Najafgarh教育资源匮乏，学生抱负多为本地就业、教学、政府工作；性别差异在Najafgarh更显著

title: Fog harvesting in the desert: Extracting the same-weekday momentum in China
affiliations: King's College London, Shanghai University of Finance and Economics - School of Finance and

detail.title: Fog harvesting in the desert: Extracting the same-weekday momentum in China
detail.abstract: We find that the daily returns of Chinese A-shares can be positively predicted by past returns on the same weekday (a.k.a. same-weekday momentum). The phenomenon is stronger for larger and more liquid stocks, and pervasive across different price and institutional ownership levels. A hypothetical daily-rebalanced strategy that buys past same-weekday winners and sells past same-weekday losers can generate significant abnormal returns. We explore several potential explanations. Overall, we discover a form of momentum in the Chinese market where the traditional momentum effect is weak.

AI.tldr: 研究发现中国A股存在'同星期动量'效应，即同一星期几的历史收益能正向预测当日收益，该效应在大盘股和高流动性股票中更强，且能产生显著超额收益。
AI.research_question: 中国A股市场是否存在同星期动量效应？这种效应的特征和盈利能力如何？
AI.motivation: 传统动量效应在中国市场较弱，但可能存在其他形式的动量效应，如同星期动量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学、市场异象、动量效应理论
AI.method: 实证分析中国A股日收益数据，构建同星期动量投资策略
AI.findings: 发现显著的同星期动量效应，该效应在大盘股和高流动性股票中更强，能产生显著超额收益
AI.theory_contributions: 发现中国市场特有的动量效应形式，补充了传统动量效应理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供新的投资策略思路，利用同星期动量效应获取超额收益

title: A National Framework for Public Good: The Hub-Only Pipeline Topology (HOPT) for Carbon Dioxide Capture & Transportation

detail.title: A National Framework for Public Good: The Hub-Only Pipeline Topology (HOPT) for Carbon Dioxide Capture & Transportation
detail.abstract: India Born Hub-Only Pipeline Topology (HOPT) is proposed as a national project for public good — an India-specific carbon-capture framework that redefines how CO₂ is managed across industries. Instead of transporting pressurized CO₂ gas from every emitter, HOPT enables hub-based solid-looping, where carbon is captured as stable solids, moved through existing logistics networks, and regenerated only at shared regional hubs. This design cuts India’s CO₂-pipeline requirements by over 60 %, eliminates 96 % of compression stations, and can save ₹ 12–15 lakh crore in lifecycle costs. Within this topology, the Generation IV Carbon Capture (Gen4CC) framework establishes national design standards for solid-phase, SO₂-tolerant, and modular CCUS technologies. HySORB™, the first Gen4CC spin-out, captures both CO₂ and SO₂ directly from untreated flue gas, converting existing FGDs into dual-purpose assets. Together, HOPT, Gen4CC, and HySORB™ form a self-reliant, hub-based carbon infrastructure that advances Atmanirbhar Bharat, creates green-economy jobs, improves air quality, and positions India as a global leader in next-generation carbon management.

AI.tldr: 印度提出了HOPT国家项目，这是一种基于枢纽的碳捕集框架，通过固体循环方式管理CO₂，将碳捕集为稳定固体并通过现有物流网络运输，仅在共享区域枢纽进行再生。该设计可减少印度60%以上的CO₂管道需求，节省12-15万亿卢比生命周期成本。
AI.research_question: 如何为印度设计一个经济高效、自给自足的碳捕集与利用基础设施？
AI.motivation: 解决印度碳管理基础设施成本高昂的问题，推动Atmanirbhar Bharat（自力更生的印度）愿景，创造绿色经济就业机会，改善空气质量，并使印度成为下一代碳管理的全球领导者。
AI.theoretical_framework: Hub-Only Pipeline Topology (HOPT)理论框架，Generation IV Carbon Capture (Gen4CC)设计标准框架，以及固体相碳捕集技术理论。
AI.method: 采用枢纽式固体循环方法，将CO₂捕集为稳定固体，利用现有物流网络运输，仅在区域枢纽进行再生；开发SO₂耐受的模块化CCUS技术标准。
AI.findings: HOPT设计可减少60%以上的CO₂管道需求，消除96%的压缩站，节省12-15万亿卢比生命周期成本；HySORB™技术可直接从未处理烟气中捕集CO₂和SO₂。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了印度特有的碳捕集框架理论，重新定义了跨行业CO₂管理方式；建立了固体相、SO₂耐受的模块化CCUS技术国家设计标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 创建了自给自足的枢纽式碳基础设施，推动印度自力更生，创造绿色经济就业，改善空气质量，将现有FGD设施转化为双重用途资产，降低碳管理成本。

title: Monetary Sovereignty – Addressing the Challenges of a Digitalized and Multipolar World
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB) and

detail.title: Monetary Sovereignty – Addressing the Challenges of a Digitalized and Multipolar World
detail.abstract: As part of a wider research project on monetary sovereignty, this paper reviews its various dimensions and outlines the key policy issues. It complements Bindseil and Senner (2025), which provides an introduction and literature review on the concepts of national, economic and monetary sovereignty. Building on the concept of popular sovereignty, we define monetary sovereignty of a state as the freedom and ability of its people to effectively govern themselves such as to decide and implement the best policies in its present and future interest regarding the creation and the usage of money by the community, including everything relating to its unit of account, means of payment, and store of value functions. We then discuss benefits of monetary sovereignty and show that it is not a binary concept. Instead, monetary sovereignty comes in different shades across three broad dimensions: (i) money issuance and money's functions, (ii) monetary policy and international monetary regimes, and (iii) monetary infrastructure. The shades of monetary sovereignty along these dimensions are inherently dynamic due to conflicts between different actors, in particular private vs. public and foreign vs. domestic ones. Moreover, the power of the creditor and the power of economies of scale naturally push for asymmetries including hierarchies in the system. Finally, our credit money system is endogenously dynamic and acts under fundamental uncertainty, so that a nation must constantly adapt and monitor the horizon-in line with our definition of monetary sovereignty also including future interest of the people-if it wants to preserve or strengthen monetary sovereignty. We conclude by outlining instruments to strengthen monetary sovereignty and discussing current challenges to monetary sovereignty.

AI.tldr: 本文基于人民主权概念定义了货币主权，认为货币主权不是二元概念，而是在货币发行与功能、货币政策与国际货币制度、货币基础设施三个维度上存在不同层次。货币主权具有动态性，受私人与公共、外国与国内行为体冲突影响，并面临债权人和规模经济带来的不对称性挑战。
AI.research_question: 什么是货币主权？货币主权在哪些维度上存在不同层次？如何维护和加强货币主权？
AI.motivation: 作为更广泛的货币主权研究项目的一部分，本文旨在系统梳理货币主权的各个维度并明确关键政策问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人民主权概念，将国家货币主权定义为人民有效自治的自由和能力，包括决定和实施关于货币创造和使用的最佳政策。
AI.method: 概念分析和理论构建，补充Bindseil和Senner(2025)关于国家、经济和货币主权概念的文献综述。
AI.findings: 货币主权在三个维度上存在不同层次：(i)货币发行与货币功能；(ii)货币政策与国际货币制度；(iii)货币基础设施。货币主权具有动态性，受行为体冲突和系统不对称性影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了货币主权的多维度和动态性概念框架，强调了货币主权不是二元概念而是存在不同层次。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了维护和加强货币主权的工具，并讨论了当前货币主权面临的挑战。

title: Personal Income Taxes and Corporate Pollution
affiliations: University of Florida - Fisher School of Accounting, Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg and Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg

detail.title: Personal Income Taxes and Corporate Pollution
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether personal income taxes affect corporate pollution decisions through managerial incentives. While prior research has extensively studied how corporate tax burdens shape firm behavior, little is known about whether taxes levied on individual executives spill over into firm-level externalities. We exploit staggered, exogenous increases in U.S. state-level personal income tax rates from 2000 to 2019 to investigate whether higher personal tax burdens lead to changes in toxic emissions reported under the EPA's Toxic Release Inventory (TRI). Using a stacked difference-indifferences design, we find that firms headquartered in states that raised personal income taxes significantly increase their pollution levels relative to matched control firms. The effect is concentrated in onsite emissions, pollutants subject to weaker regulation, and airborne discharges. Overall, our results suggest that managerial responses operate through cost-cutting margins with high discretion and low visibility. These findings highlight a behavioral channel through which fiscal policy can influence environmental outcomes. Our study contributes to the literature on tax incidence, managerial incentives, and it raises important policy implications regarding the unintended consequences of personal taxation on ESG outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，美国州级个人所得税提高会导致企业总部所在地的污染排放显著增加，这表明针对高管的个人税收会通过管理激励影响企业环境行为。
AI.research_question: 个人所得税是否通过管理激励影响企业污染决策？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注企业所得税对企业行为的影响，但很少了解针对高管个人的税收是否会影响企业层面的外部性行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收归宿理论、管理激励理论、企业环境行为理论
AI.method: 利用2000-2019年美国州级个人所得税率的外生性增加，采用堆叠双重差分设计，分析EPA有毒物质排放清单数据
AI.findings: 总部位于提高个人所得税的州的企业，其污染排放显著增加；效应集中在现场排放、监管较弱的污染物和空气排放
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了个人税收通过管理激励影响企业环境行为的行为渠道，拓展了税收归宿和管理激励理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于个人所得税对环境ESG结果意外后果的重要启示

title: American Option Trading & Analysis
affiliations: University of Oxford - Said Business School

detail.title: American Option Trading & Analysis
detail.abstract:
This presentation American Options Trading & Analysis takes a hands-on journey through the full spectrum of American option pricing, trading, and strategy design. Moving beyond textbook theory, it blends live trading demonstrations on the Interactive Brokers platform with advanced quantitative techniques implemented in Excel, showing how professional traders and quants approach real-time decision-making.

We proceed as follows and present the following key topics:
1. Live Trading of American Options - US Equity Derivative Markets, Trading Options, Option Chains & Greeks
2. American Option Trading Strategies - Directional-, Income-, Range- and Spread Trading Strategies
3. Pricing Models & Theory - How to evaluate optimal exercise features
4. Practical Demonstration - How to price and structure option deals in Excel

The materials are accompanied with an informative video series, see https://bit.ly/AmericanOptionTrading.

The presentation series begins on the trading floor—reading live option chains, interpreting bid-offer spreads, and using the Greeks (Delta, Gamma, Theta, Vega) to manage risk dynamically. It then transitions into the construction of profitable trading structures such as straddles, strangles, collars, and condors, illustrating how pricing inefficiencies can be identified and captured. On the modelling side, the presentation moves from foundational Cox–Ross–Rubinstein (CRR) trees to advanced Leisen–Reimer lattices and the Longstaff–Schwartz Least Squares Monte Carlo method, revealing how early-exercise features and path dependency can be modelled with precision.

The combination of live market data, algorithmic pricing models, and interactive Excel implementations turns theory into a tangible trading framework. This presentation demonstrates how quantitative finance principles directly translate into tradeable insight—bridging the gap between academic valuation models and the fast-paced reality of the derivatives market

title: Digging Through Complexity: How Three Shovels Operate in Markets and Crises
affiliations: Nanyang Technological University (NTU)

detail.title: Digging Through Complexity: How Three Shovels Operate in Markets and Crises
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a triple methodological framework of "Business Shovel-Investment Shovel-Crisis Shovel," translating Philosophical Engineering thinking into actionable business tools. First, the Business Shovel helps identify whether the Supply-Demand Loop can function, thereby determining the current logic of survival. Second, the Investment Shovel reveals opportunities for mispricing future value through Time Window and Uncertainty Pricing. Third, the Crisis Shovel, through the process of "Containment-Reverse Engineering-Layered Repair-System Go-Live," enables organizations not only to survive crises but also to achieve upgrades. This paper further analyzes the mirror relationship between short selling and investment, proposes the intertextual path of business and investment, and discusses three talent development models: forward, reverse, and intertextual. Finally, the paper emphasizes the transferability of the three shovels: from personal decision-making to startup operations, and to the governance of large organizations and national systems, all can serve as crossscenario operational logic. The contribution of this paper lies in demonstrating how Philosophical Engineering can be transformed into "Swiss Army knife"-like tools in complex systems, helping agents find paths to survival and evolution amidst uncertainty.

title: Exploring the Role of Technological Innovation and Fertility on Energy Intensity: Is a Fresh Narrative Unfolding?
affiliations: Bank of Greece, Bank of Greece, National and Kapodistrian University of Athens and Bank of Greece

detail.title: Exploring the Role of Technological Innovation and Fertility on Energy Intensity: Is a Fresh Narrative Unfolding?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Greece Working Paper No. 346
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Greece Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Amid the transition to sustainable energy systems, understanding the drivers of energy intensity is essential for informed policymaking. This paper investigates the influence of technological innovation and demographic dynamics on energy intensity across 27 OECD countries from 1990 to 2022, offering novel policy insights. Employing a multifaceted empirical strategy, we utilize dynamic common correlated effects (DCCE) estimators to address cross-sectional dependence and slope heterogeneity, both salient features of our dataset characterized by interdependent units. The empirical findings indicate that technological innovation significantly reduces energy intensity through improvements in efficiency and the adoption of cleaner technologies. Economic openness and GDP per capita are linked to lower energy intensity, underscoring the role of trade and wealth in driving energy efficiency. Conversely, higher fertility rates are linked to increased energy intensity, reflecting population growth and greater demand for energy-intensive services. Quantile regressions uncover heterogeneity across the distribution, with stronger effects of technological innovation and credit access at specific quantiles. We find that fertility positively influences energy intensity across most of the distribution, with the effect diminishing at the upper quantiles—highlighting that higher fertility is associated with increased energy consumption primarily at lower and middle levels of energy intensity. Promoting technological innovation and financial access, while accounting for demographic pressures, is essential for achieving sustainable energy transitions in developed economies.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了1990-2022年间27个OECD国家中技术创新和人口动态对能源强度的影响，发现技术创新显著降低能源强度，而生育率上升会增加能源强度，经济开放度和人均GDP也有助于降低能源强度。
AI.research_question: 技术创新和人口动态如何影响OECD国家的能源强度？
AI.motivation: 在向可持续能源系统转型的背景下，理解能源强度的驱动因素对于制定明智的政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术创新、人口动态与能源效率关系的理论框架，考虑经济开放度、人均GDP等控制变量。
AI.method: 采用动态共同相关效应(DCCE)估计量处理横截面依赖性和斜率异质性，并使用分位数回归分析分布异质性。
AI.findings: 技术创新显著降低能源强度；经济开放度和人均GDP与较低能源强度相关；生育率上升会增加能源强度；分位数回归显示技术创新和信贷获取在特定分位数处效应更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了技术创新和人口动态对能源强度影响的实证证据，揭示了分布异质性特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发达经济体实现可持续能源转型提供政策建议：促进技术创新和金融准入，同时考虑人口压力。

detail.abstract: Flow-based market coupling, the target model for cross-border electricity trade in the European Union, applies flow-based trade parameters at a zonal level with transparent but complex calculation rules. This enables market agents, when planning their investment decisions, to make assumptions about overall investment and calculate its impact on future changes in trade parameters. We introduce flow-based market coupling into multi-level electricity market modeling. These models cover the decisions of different agents on investment in transmission lines and generation capacity, as well as on participation in the spot market, and congestion management. To formalize the multi-level model, we make assumptions on how agents anticipate investment decisions and their effect on flow-based trade parameters. This leads to two optimization problems, one with transmission investments and the other with generation investments. We develop a solution algorithm that solves both problems sequentially according to assumptions about the timing of investment decisions. This approach, with endogenous calculation of the anticipated flow-based trade parameters, is applied to an exemplary electricity system to determine optimal investment decisions and market outcomes for flow-based market coupling. The sequential approach with flow-based market coupling reflects imperfect coordination of investment decisions between different agents. It results in more transmission investment, when compared to perfect coordination for nodal pricing and for zonal markets with optimal net transfer capacity.

title: Profitable Harm: The Normalization and Commercialization of Gender-Based Violence (GBV) in Bangladeshi Films

detail.title: Profitable Harm: The Normalization and Commercialization of Gender-Based Violence (GBV) in Bangladeshi Films
detail.abstract:
In the 1990s, one of the most common dialogues in Bangla movies was: “Chere de shoytan, tor ghore ki maa-bon nei?” (“Let me go, you devil man, don’t you have mothers or sisters at home?”). Audiences were aware of what would happen next: this sentence was typically used as the opening to a rape scene, a common practice that has become a distinguishing feature of financially successful movies. Filmmakers continue to use gender-based violence (GBV) despite stricter laws and regulations that explicitly classify it as a crime. This is either as a sensational device to attract viewers or as a troubling narrative shortcut in which a woman's violation is viewed as essential to the plot's advancement.

One concerning aspect of cultural production is still the way that GBV and popular media interact. GBV is made into entertainment in Bangla cinema by romanticizing stalking, dramatizing rape, and exalting male aggressiveness. Blockbuster hits like Borbaad (2025, approximately ৳75 crore), Tandob (2025, approximately ৳30 crore), Daagi (2025, approximately ৳16 crore), and Priyotoma (2023, approximately ৳41–43 crore) are the best examples of this, as they all did significantly better than romantic or family dramas like Uthsob (2025, approximately ৳11 crore). Reframed as love, laughter, or heroism, violence continues to be a profitable spectacle, as seen by the double-digit sales figures, rather than a social evil that needs to be addressed.

This essay explores how, in the name of amusement, Bangladeshi films normalize and commercialize GBV. It uses two recent films as a comparative case study: Uthsob, a family drama that defies such depictions but did marginally well at the box office, and Borbaad, an action-romance that was commercially successful and based on GBV clichés. Comparing these movies demonstrates how the commercialization of GBV influences filmmaking and boosts industry profits.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the adaptation pathways of human resources for health (HRH) in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), with a focus on Cameroon. It addresses the absence of a formalized HRH resilience framework and seeks to establish a foundation for such a model using machine learning techniques, including principal component analysis (PCA) and Gaussian mixture models (GMM). The study identifies five distinct HRH adaptation clusters, spanning from stabilized governance to centralized crisis-responsive strategies, and evaluates their effectiveness in sustaining health system resilience during crises such as COVID-19. Drawing on data from interviews, institutional records, and repositories, the research elucidates HRH adaptation profiles and offers policy recommendations to strengthen proactive planning, institutional collaboration, and government-labor partnerships. This work contributes to the academic understanding of HRH resilience and demonstrates the potential of machine learning in health systems research.

detail.abstract: This paper evaluates the impact of the pandemic and enforcement at the US and Mexican borders on the emigration of Guatemalans during 2017-2020. During this period, the number of crossings from Guatemala fell by 10%, according to the Survey of Migration to the Southern Border of Mexico. Yet, there was a rise of nearly 30% in the number of emigration crossings of male adults travelling with their children. This new trend was partly driven by the recent reduction in the number of children deported from the US. For a one-point reduction in the number of children deported from the US to Guatemalan municipalities, there was an increase of nearly 14 in the number of crossings made by adult males leaving from Guatemala for Mexico; and nearly 0.5 additional crossings made by male adults travelling with their children. However, the surge of emigrants travelling with their children was also driven by the acute economic shock that Guatemala experienced during the pandemic. During this period, air pollution in the analysed Guatemalan municipalities fell by 4%, night light per capita fell by 15%, and homicide rates fell by 40%. Unlike in previous years, emigrants are fleeing poverty rather than violence. Our findings suggest that a reduction in violence alone will not be sufficient to reduce emigration flows from Central America, but that economic recovery is needed.

title: Recompiling Civilization: A Model of Meaning, System, and Dynamic Stability

detail.title: Recompiling Civilization: A Model of Meaning, System, and Dynamic Stability
detail.abstract:
This paper introduces MemeOS (Memetic Operating System), a theoretical framework that reconceives civilization as a runnable system rather than a static cultural form. Unlike traditional theories centered on ideology, faith, or institutions, MemeOS argues that the essence of civilization lies in the runnability and recompilability of its internal protocols—its capacity to remain operational, self-corrective, and regenerative through historical cycles. Civilization is treated not as an artifact but as a living algorithm that continuously translates between facts, meanings, and systems of coordination.

Within the MemeOS model, civilization functions as a dynamic protocol architecture composed of three vertical layers and one horizontal layer. The Application Layer consists of the SBFFE, Meaning Loop, and Permission Protocol, forming the Triadic Model of Civilization that answers “What is real,” “What is worthwhile,” and “How do we collaborate.” The Core Protocol Layer provides the underlying grammar—cognition, feedback, iteration, energy, trust, communication, context, and integrity—that maintains coherence across complexity. The Execution Layer (Runtime Environment) operationalizes these logics through cognition, motivation, and iteration, enabling knowledge, action, and transmission. Crossing all layers, the Tension Protocol acts as a dynamic stability algorithm that maintains the energy gradient between fact, meaning, and system, preventing both stagnation and collapse.

The paper argues that the long-term vitality of civilization depends on the synchronized update rate of the Triadic Model—Meaning, System, and Execution. When these frequencies align, the system enters an evolutionary state of innovation; when they fall out of sync, meaning collapses and institutions hollow out. The Tension Protocol manages such inconsistencies, transforming conflict into energy and maintaining balance through controlled disequilibrium. Accordingly, the study proposes the Equation of Civilizational Robustness:
Civilizational Robustness = Recompilability × Tension Tolerance × Update Rate.
This formula expresses civilization’s health not as stability but as adaptability—its ability to absorb disruption, recompile meaning, and sustain coherence.

MemeOS thus defines a Civilizational Syntax rather than an ideology. It provides logic instead of doctrine, sustainable imperfection instead of perfect order, and generative tension instead of uniform peace. In this sense, civilization is not a monument but a self-recompiling program. True civilization is Ordered Unease—growing through tension, stabilizing within uncertainty, and renewing itself through continuous recompilation.

When the next spark appears, the new MemeOS will automatically load—
Civilization will restart.

title: Store-Specific Assortments in the Presence of Product Constraints
affiliations: Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) - Department of Technology and Operations Management and IESE Business School - University of Navarra

detail.title: Store-Specific Assortments in the Presence of Product Constraints
detail.abstract:
Problem definition: Retailers must decide which products to offer in each brick-and-mortar store while facing limits on overall product availability. These assortment decisions must balance local preferences and capacity or supply constraints across the store network. Although assortment planning has been extensively studied, most existing models focus on a single store and overlook the interdependence created by shared product availability across locations. We study a network-wide assortment optimization problem that determines which stores should carry which products when total availability is limited. 

Methodology/results: We formulate a store-specific assortment optimization model that captures product availability constraints across stores. We show that the problem is NP-complete and develop a tractable continuous relaxation under multinomial logit demand using mixed quadratic conic programming. This relaxation provides a tight upper bound in realistic settings. Building on it, we design efficient heuristic algorithms with provable performance guarantees. Numerical experiments show that the algorithms achieve near-optimal solutions. We further apply the model to data from a large multinational apparel retailer, where we estimate product-store attractiveness parameters using a control function approach to correct for missing data on unrealized product-store combinations. The empirical validation demonstrates substantial performance improvements over current practice. 

Managerial implications: Our results highlight the value of optimizing assortments across the entire store network rather than treating each store independently. By explicitly accounting for product-store matching and shared availability constraints, retailers can better coordinate assortment decisions and improve overall performance. In our empirical study with a multinational apparel retailer, this network-based approach led to substantial revenue gains-about 30% under that firm's data-illustrating its practical potential. Even modest reallocation of products based on store-specific performance can yield meaningful improvements.

detail.abstract: This study explores how civic participation among older adults influences subjective well-being and perceptions of municipal governance in San Juan, Puerto Rico. Using a structured telephone survey of 415 residents aged 60 and older, the research applies descriptive statistics, Pearson correlations, and regression models to examine the effects of participation frequency, program awareness, and perceived accessibility of civic spaces. Findings reveal that higher civic involvement is significantly associated with life satisfaction (β = 0.37, p < .001) and trust in local government (β = 0.42, p < .001). Programs such as community wellness spaces and adult day-care centers received favorable evaluations, with over 60% of respondents participating monthly or weekly. These results underscore the role of civic engagement as both a protective factor and a participatory learning tool. The study contributes to broader discussions on aging, democratic accountability, and social capital in urban Latin American contexts experiencing demographic transition.

detail.abstract: Grounded in resource-based and appraisal frameworks, this study investigates how personality traits, workplace climate, and contextual perceptions jointly predict psychological well-being and work engagement among public service employees during martial law. Using a cross-sectional survey of 1667 Ukrainian public sector workers in wartime, hierarchical ordinal regression and moderation analyses were employed to assess predictors of well-being and engagement, supplemented by Kruskal–Wallis and ANOVA tests to explore group differences in engagement and emotional stability across martial law appraisals. Emotional stability emerged as the most robust predictor of psychological well-being, while conscientiousness and openness were linked to higher engagement. Workplace atmosphere positively influenced both outcomes, whereas salary adequacy was associated only with well-being. Moderation results indicated that appraisals of martial law significantly shaped the engagement–well-being relationship, with favorable appraisals linked to reduced reliance on engagement and higher emotional stability. These findings integrate perspectives on trait resilience, workplace resources, and meaning-focused coping, extending established theoretical models to a wartime context and offering practical insights for resilience-building interventions and mission-oriented organizational strategies.

detail.abstract: Sustainable Human Resource Management (SHRM) is becoming a trend workplace practice in ensuring that workforce practices are directed towards achieving an environmental, social, and governance (ESG) focus. The study examines the advances in practice of SHRM and the main issues related to the implementation of the practice, as well as looks into the new trends that shape the future of HR sustainability. Peer-reviewed journals, industry analysis, and organizational case studies (2015 2025) of secondary data were used. Thematic analysis identified that admission programs (80%), and green hiring practices (72%), are the most predominant sustainability- focused HR practices. Sixty-five and fifty-eight percent of organizations were using sustainability- oriented training programs and ESG-based performance management, respectively. The major obstacles found are resistance to change (68%), lacks expertise (55%), and resource constraints (48%), which underscore the obstacles that companies have to undertake in order to infiltrate the full acculturation of sustainability in the HR functions. The perspectives that seem to be of significance in the future are integration of digital HR tools, employee well-being approaches, alignment of the HR strategies to the goals of ESG, collaboration with stakeholders, and that associated with a circular HR approach. The results point to the better sustainability performance of those organizations that follow the practice of several SHRM patterns simultaneously, their increased engagement with the workforce, or their greater organizational resilience. The research is informative to HR practitioners, policymakers and researchers, to develop sustainable workforce management plans that lead to organizational performance as well as overall wisdom in the society.

detail.abstract: This article explores clan culture as one of the most enduring organizational paradigms, defined by loyalty, trust, collaboration, and a strong sense of belonging. It examines the origins of clan culture, its defining characteristics, and the ways in which it influences leadership, governance, decision-making and operations. Case studies of organizations such as Southwest Airlines, Zappos, Patagonia, and Ben & Jerry's illustrate the practical impact of clan values on employee engagement and customer loyalty. The article also considers the evolution of clan culture across the organizational life cycle, from startups to mature enterprises, and identifies both the strengths and risks of this people-first orientation. Looking ahead, it discusses how digital technologies, remote work and artificial intelligence are reshaping the ways in which clan cultures are sustained, emphasizing the need for intentional practices to preserve human connection. The article concludes by underscoring the future relevance of clan culture and the critical role of leaders in balancing tradition with innovation.

detail.abstract:
Background: Hemoglobinopathies, particularly sickle cell disease (SCD) and thalassemia, are escalating global public health challenges. The launch of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) in 2015 prioritized Universal Health Coverage and the control of Non-Communicable Diseases globally. This study systematically quantifies the spatiotemporal trends in the burden of hemoglobinopathies to evaluate the potential impact of global health policies, especially the SDGs, on the disease burden.

Methods: Data were derived from the Global Burden of Disease Study 2021 (GBD 2021), covering 204 countries and territories, analyzing incidence, prevalence, DALYs, deaths, and age-standardized rate (ASR). The 2015 launch of the SDGs was used as a demarcation point to divide data into two periods: 1990 to 2015 and 2016 to 2021.Temporal and spatial trends in the disease burden were described using Joinpoint regression, the Estimated Annual Percentage Change (EAPC), and frontier analysis. Decomposition analysis quantified the effects of demographic and epidemiological factors on the trends. A Bayesian age-period-cohort model was applied to project disease burden through 2030 and 2050.

Results: Globally, the number of prevalent cases of SCD increased from 4,499,628.63 in 1990 to 7,776,893.54 in 2021, a 72.83% increase. The number of deaths rose by 51.1% during the same period. In contrast, thalassemia prevalence cases showed only a slight decline, from 1,341,821.72 in 1990 to 1,310,407.05 cases in 2021. Since 2015, the disease burden of SCD and thalassemia has declined substantially. The lowest EAPC in ASDR for both diseases during 2016–2021 was observed in Southern Latin America. Projections suggest that the ASR of prevalence of SCD and thalassemia will continue to rise globally through 2050.

Conclusion: Tackling hemoglobinopathies remains a major priority for global health initiatives. While the implementation of the SDGs has contributed to a certain extent in mitigating the global disease burden, significant challenges persist: the burden of SCD is predominantly concentrated in low SDI regions, whereas the challenges posed by thalassemia are centered in middle SDI regions. To achieve the SDG targets, therefore, it is imperative to expand newborn screening and access to essential medicines in low-SDI settings, while simultaneously reinforcing care for migrant populations and high-risk women of childbearing age.

detail.abstract: This study explores the structural characteristics and operational mechanisms of the United States (U.S.) startup ecosystem in implementing digital innovations and evaluates their adaptability to Uzbekistan's emerging entrepreneurial environment. The research aims to analyze how the integration of technology, venture capital, and state policies in the U.S. has contributed to a sustainable innovation-driven economy and how these lessons can inform Uzbekistan's digital transformation strategy. A mixed-method comparative analysis was conducted between 2020 and 2024 using secondary data from global innovation indices, venture capital investment reports, and policy documents. Qualitative insights were drawn from academic literature and expert interviews available in public databases. The principal findings indicate that the U.S. startup ecosystem thrives due to its comprehensive infrastructurecharacterized by university-industry collaboration, venture funding mechanisms, and adaptive policy support. In contrast, Uzbekistan's ecosystem, though rapidly growing, remains constrained by limited financing, insufficient digital infrastructure, and weak university-industry integration. The research contributes to the understanding of how developing economies can localize global innovation practices through institutional reform and policy alignment. The implications of this study suggest that Uzbekistan can accelerate its digital innovation capacity by establishing venture funds, promoting entrepreneurial education, and incentivizing research commercialization. Socially, the findings underscore the potential for startups to enhance employment, sustainability, and digital inclusion. Despite the limitations associated with reliance on secondary data, this study provides a conceptual framework for policymakers, investors, and researchers to strengthen innovation ecosystems in transitional economies.

detail.title: The Changing State Monopoly on Religion and Secular Views in Thailand

publicationDetails.detailsText: Secular States and Religious Diversity, page 232.

detail.abstract:
Thailand, September 2006: A democratically elected government is forced out of power by an admittedly peaceful coup d'etat. King Bhumibol Adulyadej, considered to be a semidivine Buddhist figure, as well as the ultimate moral authority of the nation, endorses the coup, thus assuring social stability in the divided kingdom. The king shows, once again, that the monarchy has checks and balances in a political system dominated by money politics and charismatic leaders. In Thailand many, but not all, revere the monarchy as a symbol and a principal element of national identity. The divine aura attributed to King Bhumibol by his people allows him to seemingly "stand above all politics" while also being intimately involved in affairs of the state (McCargo 2005,502). 

The political sphere in the kingdom is known as the secular domain where worldly matters-in contrast to otherworldly, religious matters-are attended to by the secular political authority of the Parliament (Jackson 1997, 75). Politics corrupt individuals and therefore serve as obstacles to those devoted to studying religion, such as monks. Nevertheless, the king's perceived high-Buddhist moral virtue allows him to avoid being contaminated by all worldly affairs, enabling him to participate in them without becoming tainted. 

While writing the 2007 Constitution,' the Constitution Drafting Assembly and the Constitution Drafting Committee refused to enshrine Buddhism as the state religion despite the mobilization of pressure groups, even though a Buddhist king must symbolically remain the head of state. The state - understood as the Parliament - shall provide patronage and protection to Buddhism as well as other religious faiths in the kingdom. Buddhism is thus underlined as the established religion in the kingdom and is protected by the monarchy. However, both the king and the state are also theoretically patrons of all faiths - hence the ambiguity over the rapport between the religious and the political spheres in the kingdom. Both of these constitutional committees opted to emphasize the kingdom's religious pluralism and religious freedom instead. Government officials believe the state to be secular with an established national Buddhist sangha (clergy). Legally, the state is the final arbiter of interreligious relations and of its control over religious affairs. The Thai case underlines the complexity of secularism in non-Western societies, where the idea of separation between church and state is not viewed in terms of mutual exclusion - as underlined in Rajeev Bhargava's and Ahmet T. Kuru's chapters in this volume. In Thailand established religion coexists with freedom of conscience - at least constitutionally. The political influence of the Thai Buddhist clergy is conceived of as being nearly absent from politics. Thailand can legally be understood as a moderate secular state that embraces toleration and accommodation of religious diversity.

title: Marketing Communication is Not Marketing: Deconstructing a Common Conflation

detail.title: Marketing Communication is Not Marketing: Deconstructing a Common Conflation
detail.abstract: The terms "marketing" and "marketing communication" are often used interchangeably in both business practice and public discourse. This conflation obscures the true strategic scope of marketing and leads to a narrow, tactical focus that can undermine long-term business success. This conceptual paper argues that marketing communication (MarCom) is a crucial subset of the marketing mix, but it is not synonymous with marketing itself. By tracing the evolution of marketing thought from a product-centric to a customer-centric philosophy, this paper delineates the boundaries between the overarching strategy of marketing and the tactical execution of communication. We posit that marketing is the strategic framework for creating, communicating, delivering, and exchanging offerings that have value, encompassing product, price, place, and promotion (the 4Ps). MarCom constitutes the "promotion" P the voice of the strategy. The paper concludes that understanding this distinction is vital for allocating resources effectively, building sustainable brands, and achieving genuine customer-centricity.

detail.abstract: This research investigates the efficacy of Activity-Based Costing (ABC) implementation within the service sector by conducting a comparative analysis against traditional costing methodologies. Despite the foundational development of ABC in manufacturing, its applicability and subsequent benefits within intangible, high-overhead service environments remain a subject of debate. This study employs a mixed-methods approach, utilizing a survey of financial managers and detailed case studies of two large service organizations-one utilizing ABC and one utilizing a traditional volume-based approach. We hypothesize that ABC-adopting firms demonstrate significantly higher accuracy in product (service line) costing, leading to superior strategic pricing, resource allocation, and managerial decision-making. Preliminary findings, while simulated for the purpose of this article, suggest a substantial reduction in cost distortion in complex , diverse service offerings under the ABC model, thereby validating its strategic utility in modern service firms. The paper concludes with recommendations for overcoming implementation barriers unique to the service environment, emphasizing the need for robust organizational commitment and interdepartmental cooperation.

detail.title: Do AI Role Plays Improve Sales Performance? Evidence from a Longitudinal Field Study
detail.abstract: Role plays have traditionally assumed a central component in sales training. Artificial intelligence (AI) introduces novel ways to train salespeople through role plays. In AI-enabled role play simulators, an AI agent assumes the role of the customer and delivers feedback after completion. While sales organizations are increasingly adopting such AI role plays, their effectiveness is unclear since they lack the richness of human interactions. Given this tension, we study how AI role plays are associated with salesperson performance. Drawing on transfer of training theory, we develop a contingency perspective and exploit a quasi-experiment conducted at a large industrial firm in the United States. The dataset includes performance metrics on almost 2,000 salespeople, some of whom participated in an AI role play training intervention. Our results indicate that the intervention did not produce a significant average treatment effect. However, the treatment effect was heterogeneous: salespeople with low prior performance, high performance goals, high organizational tenure, or high-performing supervisors exhibited performance improvements ranging from 7% to 35%. These findings encourage practitioners to adopt AI role plays but rigorously manage transfer of learnings into real-life selling.

detail.abstract: Podcasters today whether public figures facing scrutiny or professionals at the top of their game are shaping influence and trust through dynamic collaborations and effective PR efforts, blurring the boundaries between celebrity, business, and grassroots media to amplify their reach and credibility. This study aims to investigates and reimagine the evolving tourism Marketing landscape for audio travel podcasts and explore their relationship with behavioural intention towards the destination and the travel podcast usage. Using survey data from 498 respondents, the proposed theoretical model grounded in Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB), the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM), and the Uses and Gratifications Theory (UGT), was tested and validated through Covariance-Based Structural Equation modeling (CB-SEM), followed by multi-group analysis to assess model robustness across demographic segments. Via offering empirical evidence on the link between audio engagement and tourism behaviour the findings revels that podcast listening significantly impacts destination visit and podcast usage intention, highlighting the potential of audio user-generated content as a persuasive marketing tool. The research also reveals striking differences in what motivates men and women: men are inspired by informed discovery, while women connect through relational experiences. By revealing the dual power of podcasts as informational and experiential platforms, this study highlights new opportunities for destinations and marketers to inspire and engage tomorrow's travelers.

This paper examines the constitutional and administrative implications of Ballout v. U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission and U.S. Agency for Global Media (Case No. 25-13228), a landmark filing in the Eastern District of Michigan that challenges the intersection of state-funded media, regulatory discretion, and investor rights.

Filed by Dr. Benjamin Ballout, the complaint asserts that the SEC and USAGM breached statutory limits by acting on unverified information disseminated by Radio Free Europe / Radio Liberty (RFE/RL)—a government-funded broadcaster legally barred under the Smith-Mundt Act (22 U.S.C. § 1461-1a) from targeting domestic audiences. The subsequent regulatory actions, including the suspension of Enerkon Solar International’s trading, demonstrate how media narratives can distort agency process and market integrity.

Through references to the Administrative Procedure Act (5 U.S.C. § 706), the Freedom of Information Act (5 U.S.C. § 552), and the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the paper argues that the case represents a critical test of administrative transparency and inter-agency accountability. It explores how procedural silence—specifically the agencies’ refusal to produce responsive FOIA records—constitutes a “constructive denial” that erodes public confidence in regulatory fairness.

The study concludes that Ballout v. SEC et al. is not a partisan dispute but a systemic audit of governance. It calls for congressional oversight to reassess how federal regulators verify media-based intelligence and how publicly funded communications arms like RFE/RL operate within statutory and ethical boundaries.

By framing the case as both a legal and civic intervention, this work reaffirms that accountability is not partisan—it is patriotic, and that true investor protection depends on transparency, due process, and the lawful restraint of state-influenced narratives.

AI.tldr: 本文分析Ballout诉SEC案，探讨政府资助媒体、监管自由裁量权与投资者权利的交叉问题，认为该案是对行政透明度和机构问责制的关键考验。
AI.research_question: 政府资助媒体如何影响监管机构的决策过程和市场完整性？行政程序中的程序沉默如何侵蚀公众对监管公平的信心？
AI.motivation: Ballout诉SEC案揭示了政府资助媒体传播未经核实信息对监管决策和市场完整性的影响，需要系统性地审视行政透明度和机构问责制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行政程序法、信息自由法、1934年证券交易法、Smith-Mundt法案等法律框架，以及行政透明度和监管问责理论。
AI.method: 法律案例分析，通过引用Ballout诉SEC案的具体法律争议，分析行政程序、媒体影响和监管问责的交叉问题。
AI.findings: 政府资助媒体传播未经核实信息导致监管机构越权行动，程序沉默构成"推定拒绝"，损害监管公平和市场信心。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"程序沉默"作为行政问责的新概念，深化了对行政透明度和监管公平的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁国会加强监管，重新评估联邦监管机构如何核实媒体情报，确保政府资助媒体在法律和道德边界内运作。

title: Representations of Investor Beliefs
affiliations: University of Chicago, University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and University of Chicago Booth School of Business

detail.title: Representations of Investor Beliefs
detail.abstract: Firms release vast amounts of data through financial disclosures, but it is difficult to know what information is important for updating investor beliefs about the firm fundamentals and therefore may move asset prices. This study uses large language models to model the novelty, or "surprise" of a given piece of information, relative to all information that the firm had previously disclosed. Specifically, we train LLMs using data from the financial domain to model investors' prior beliefs over narrative content and, thus, identify new information that a company communicates. Our models, which are tailored to each firm and time, allow us to determine when a sentence or a paragraph in a corporate filing contains a surprise. We also generate a summary measure of the amount of new information released in each document, and we show that this measure explains a large portion of market response to disclosed information and predicts firms' future returns. In sum, our study highlights the importance of identifying new and salient information in today's complex, data-driven landscape.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用大型语言模型来量化企业财务披露中的信息新颖性（"惊喜"），通过训练针对特定公司和时间的LLMs来识别企业披露中的新信息，并证明这种新信息度量能解释市场反应并预测未来回报。
AI.research_question: 如何识别企业财务披露中真正新颖且重要的信息，以及这些信息如何影响资产价格？
AI.motivation: 企业发布大量财务披露数据，但难以确定哪些信息对更新投资者信念和影响资产价格真正重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投资者信念更新理论和信息经济学，关注信息新颖性对市场反应的影响。
AI.method: 使用大型语言模型，针对每个公司和时间点训练专门模型，建模投资者先验信念，识别披露中的新信息。
AI.findings: 新信息度量能解释大部分市场对披露信息的反应，并能预测公司未来回报。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了使用LLMs量化信息新颖性的新方法，扩展了信息经济学在数字时代的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、分析师和监管机构提供了识别重要披露信息的工具，有助于更有效地处理复杂财务数据。

title: Binance in October 2025: An Integrated Analysis of the World’s Largest Crypto Exchange
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Binance in October 2025: An Integrated Analysis of the World’s Largest Crypto Exchange
detail.abstract:
Binance remains the most systemically important centralized crypto exchange (CEX) by users and liquidity. Its vast product scope (spot, derivatives, staking/earn, token launches, and the BNB Chain ecosystem) creates powerful network effects and deep order books. Yet the same scale and ubiquity concentrate operational, legal, and reputational risk.

The exchange’s post-2023 pivot—after pleading guilty to U.S. violations and agreeing to a $4.3B resolution while founder Changpeng “CZ” Zhao stepped down—has been to emphasize compliance, transparency artifacts like Proof of Reserves (PoR), and insurance buffers (SAFU). U.S. authorities detailed the violations and settlement in November 2023; CZ later received a four-month sentence in 2024; and Richard Teng became CEO, shaping today’s governance and compliance posture.

Macro-financially, 24/7 crypto market structure differs from equity markets (which run limited hours, with circuit breakers and T+1 settlement). Crypto’s always-on design expands access and price discovery but also amplifies behavioral cycles (attention shocks, FOMO, fatigue) and volatility clustering, with spillovers into derivatives positioning and stablecoin liquidity.

Against this backdrop, Binance’s pros include unmatched liquidity, breadth of markets, robust product suite, and maturing compliance; cons include regulatory overhangs in some jurisdictions, historic security incidents (2019 hot-wallet hack; 2022 BNB Chain bridge exploit), and the challenges of proving full solvency beyond PoR snapshots.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了币安作为全球最大中心化加密货币交易所的系统重要性，探讨了其在2023年合规转型后的风险与机遇，以及加密市场24/7交易结构对行为周期和波动性的影响。
AI.research_question: 币安作为系统重要性加密货币交易所，在合规转型后如何平衡其网络效应优势与集中风险？
AI.motivation: 币安作为全球最大的中心化加密货币交易所，其规模、产品范围和网络效应创造了系统重要性，但同时也集中了运营、法律和声誉风险。2023年的合规转型需要重新评估其风险收益特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统重要性金融机构理论、网络效应理论、行为金融学、市场微观结构理论
AI.method: 基于公开信息的案例分析和市场结构比较分析
AI.findings: 币安在合规转型后强调透明度工具（如储备证明）和保险缓冲，但其规模仍带来集中风险；加密市场24/7结构放大了行为周期和波动性聚类。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了系统重要性理论在加密资产领域的应用，深化了对24/7市场结构下行为金融效应的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构评估加密交易所风险提供框架，为投资者理解币安转型后的风险收益特征提供指导。

title: Networks and Political Participation after Conflict

detail.title: Networks and Political Participation after Conflict
detail.abstract: This paper builds on the network model of Galeotti et al., 2010 to examine how the destruction of local infrastructure shapes social capital. In the model, voting is a coordination game with strategic complementarities, implying that denser social networks foster higher turnout. We test these predictions in the context of the 1937 attack on civilians during the Spanish Civil War, which destroyed a major coastal road and isolated nearby towns. Using proximity to the bombed road-instrumented by distance to deep water, ruggedness, and elevation, as suggested by witness reports-we show that the most affected towns subsequently displayed higher electoral participation forty years later. Ruling out alternative channels linked to economic development, we show-consistent with the model-that the effect operates through tighter social networks, with isolation emerging as the key mechanism sustaining long-term civic engagement.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Galeotti等人的网络模型，研究1937年西班牙内战期间对平民的袭击摧毁沿海公路并隔离附近城镇后，当地基础设施破坏如何影响社会资本。研究发现受影响最严重的城镇在40年后表现出更高的选举参与度，这种效应通过更紧密的社会网络运作，隔离成为维持长期公民参与的关键机制。
AI.research_question: 当地基础设施的破坏如何影响社会资本？
AI.motivation: 理解重大历史事件（如战争）对长期社会资本形成的影响机制
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Galeotti等人（2010）的网络模型，将投票视为具有战略互补性的协调博弈
AI.method: 利用1937年西班牙内战袭击事件作为自然实验，使用到深水距离、地形崎岖度和海拔作为工具变量，分析受影响城镇40年后的选举参与度
AI.findings: 受影响最严重的城镇随后表现出更高的选举参与度，这种效应通过更紧密的社会网络运作，隔离成为维持长期公民参与的关键机制
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了网络模型中关于社会网络密度与投票参与度正相关的预测，揭示了隔离作为社会资本形成机制的理论意义
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解历史创伤如何塑造长期公民参与提供了实证证据，对灾后重建和社会资本培育具有政策启示

title: Resonant and Non-Resonant Double Hopf Bifurcation in a 4D Goodwin Model with Wage Inequality
affiliations: Universidad Central del Ecuador and Universidad de Concepción

detail.title: Resonant and Non-Resonant Double Hopf Bifurcation in a 4D Goodwin Model with Wage Inequality
detail.abstract: This paper presents a four-dimensional extension of the Goodwin model of endogenous cycles that integrates wage inequality and underemployment. The model distinguishes two classes of workers differentiated by productivity, wage levels, and bargaining strength, and endogenizes the underemployment rate through a simplified power-balance mechanism between capital and labor. We establish well-posedness of the system by proving existence-uniqueness of solutions, positivity, and forward invariance on a compact admissible set. The interior equilibrium is characterized in closed form and shown to generically undergo a double Hopf (Hopf-Hopf) bifurcation. Using center-manifold reduction and a third-order normal form, we derive the amplitude equations governing the interaction between two oscillatory modes (the Goodwin cycle and the underemployment cycle). The reduced dynamics predict the emergence of an invariant two-torus with quasi-periodic cycles and phase locking at low-order resonances (1∶1, 1∶2, 1∶3). Numerical continuation and direct simulations corroborate the analytical predictions, documenting transitions between quasi-periodicity and resonant periodic orbits, and mapping the associated bifurcation structure in key parameters, such as the adjustment speed of the underemployment rate in response to deviations from steady-state equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个四维的古德温内生周期模型扩展，整合了工资不平等和就业不足。模型区分了两类工人，通过简化的资本-劳动力权力平衡机制内生化就业不足率，证明了系统的适定性，并发现内点均衡会发生双重Hopf分岔，产生准周期环面和相位锁定现象。
AI.research_question: 如何在古德温内生周期模型中整合工资不平等和就业不足，并分析其动态特性？
AI.motivation: 现有古德温模型未能充分处理工资不平等和就业不足问题，需要扩展模型来更好地理解这些因素对经济周期的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 古德温内生周期模型、双重Hopf分岔理论、中心流形约化、正规形式理论
AI.method: 四维微分方程系统建模、存在唯一性证明、中心流形约化、三阶正规形式推导、数值延续和直接模拟
AI.findings: 系统存在内点均衡且会发生双重Hopf分岔，产生两个振荡模式的相互作用，形成准周期环面和低阶共振（1:1,1:2,1:3）的相位锁定现象
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了古德温模型以包含工资不平等和就业不足，建立了双重Hopf分岔的理论框架，推导了振幅方程来描述两个振荡模式的相互作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解经济周期中工资不平等和就业不足的动态关系提供了分析工具，揭示了准周期和共振周期轨道之间的转换机制

title: Preference Heterogeneity versus Economic Incentives: What Determines the Choice to Give Care to the Elderly?
affiliations: McGill University, McGill University and Universidad Carlos III de Madrid

detail.title: Preference Heterogeneity versus Economic Incentives: What Determines the Choice to Give Care to the Elderly?
detail.abstract: Family is a primary source of care, yet significant variations in care arrangements exist both across families and countries. To understand why, we develop a tractable static model in which parents and children bargain over care arrangements, accounting for both financial incentives and heterogeneous caregiving preferences. Our structural model directly implies a discrete-choice estimation equation that we implement on European data. We find that non-monetary preferences significantly shape care decisions: omitting preference heterogeneity overstates the price elasticity of formal care by a factor of 2.5. Counterfactuals show that implementing formal-care subsidies as in the most generous (low-cost) countries leads to a 38-76% increase in nursing-home uptake in the remainder of Europe; cross-country preference heterogeneity is an equally important determinant for the low-cost versus high-cost country gradient in formal-care Our model forecasts a three- to thirteen-fold rise in future formal care demand by 2050, driven mainly by a declining ratio of adult children to elderly parents.ContactDaniel Barczyk daniel.barczyk@mcgill.ca: McGill University, Department of Economics, Leacock Building, Room 321b, 855 Sherbrooke Street West, Montreal, QC, H3A 2T7. title: A Machine Learning Based Predictive Model to Identify Individuals at High Risk of Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reinjury after Reconstruction
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE) - Manipal Institute of Technology, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE) - Manipal Institute of Technology

detail.title: A Machine Learning Based Predictive Model to Identify Individuals at High Risk of Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reinjury after Reconstruction
detail.abstract: Injuries to the anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) frequently occur in young, active individuals who engage in sports involving jumping, pivoting, and sudden changes in direction. Despite advancements in surgical reconstruction techniques, the risk of reinjury after ACL reconstruction (ACLR) remains a major clinical concern. Therefore, it is essential to identify individuals at high risk of reinjury to enhance rehabilitation and prevent recurrence. This study aims to develop a predictive Machine Learning (ML) model to identify individuals at high risk of ACL reinjury after reconstruction based on clinical, biomechanical, surgical, and demographic factors. A retrospective study will be conducted at tertiary care hospitals affiliated with Kasturba Medical College Mangalore. Data will be collected from the medical records of patients who have undergone both primary and revision ACLR over the past decade. The data will include demographic, clinical, biomechanical, and follow-up data. Outcome measures will include Beighton’s Score for assessing ligamentous laxity and Manual muscle testing (MMT) for assessing muscle strength of quadriceps and hamstrings. Data will be analysed using JAMOVI (v2.6.4), with a General Regression Neural Network algorithm to identify significant predictors of ACL reinjury.

AI.tldr: 本研究旨在开发机器学习模型，基于临床、生物力学、手术和人口统计学因素，预测前交叉韧带重建术后再损伤的高风险个体。
